title: Prairie broughams match their 1893 catalogue plate; covered wagons look real
items: The four broughams driven on Prairie Avenue in 1904 now carry the closed driving box, dash and swept irons of Studebaker's 1893 plate, and lose the rear mudguards the plate never had. Each coachman still sits exactly where he was fitted.
The two covered wagons at the Western Hotel and Wolf Point in 1835 now stand on the photographed farm wagon, in their own blue-and-red and oak paints, with canvas weathered its own way.
Phones draw the covered wagons from the farm wagon's lighter level.
